피바다 지하묘지가 전장에 들어오면서, 당신은 생명 2점을 지불할 수 있다. 그러지 않으면, 피바다 지하묘지는 탭된 상태로 전장에 들어온다.

于血腥墓穴进战场时，你可以支付2点生命。如果你未如此作，血腥墓穴须横置进战场。
於血腥墓穴進戰場時，你可以支付2點生命。如果你未如此作，血腥墓穴須橫置進戰場。
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local effectController = EffectController() if effectController ~= nil then if effectController:CanPayResourceCost(1) then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_MULTIPLE_CHOICE_ANSWER_PAY_2_LIFE" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_MULTIPLE_CHOICE_ANSWER_DO_NOT_PAY_2_LIFE" ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_MULTIPLE_CHOICE_QUESTION_BLOOD_CRYPT", TriggerObject() ) EffectDC():Set_Int(0, 1) -- this flag is for later, so we know if the qustion was asked or not end end

local questionAnswer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if EffectDC():Get_Int(0) == 1 then -- only do this biz if the question was asked if questionAnswer == 0 then EffectController():PayResourceCost(1) elseif questionAnswer == 1 then if EffectSource() ~= nil then EffectSource():Tap() end end else if EffectSource() ~= nil then EffectSource():Tap() end end
